title: Beatform Gallery Registry
description: The registry consumed by the Beatform app. Every entry describes one piece of reviewed community content, pinned to an immutable commit and verified by SHA-256 before it is ever parsed.

schemaVersion.description: Version of THIS registry format. The app refuses registries newer than it understands.

entryId.description: Stable slug. Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; never reused for different content.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of the referenced file's exact bytes.

contentUrl.description: Commit-pinned raw URL into this repository. The 40-hex commit SHA makes the content immutable by construction.

previewUrl.description: Commit-pinned raw URL to a preview image stored under previews/ in this repository.

type.description: Content type. Extensible in later registry versions (shader, builder-stack).

license.description: License granted by the submitter for the content file and preview.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the content file. The app enforces this as a download limit before hashing.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the CONTENT file format (.bfpreset schemaVersion, or .bftheme projectSchemaVersion), so the app can refuse content it cannot parse without downloading it.

tombstone.description: True when the entry has been removed from circulation. Tombstoned entries stay in the index forever so IDs are never silently reused.

replacedBy.description: ID of the entry that supersedes this one, if any.
